Return & Refund Policy

60-Day 100% Money-Back Guarantee

1. 100% Satisfaction Guarantee

We stand behind HerpaFend with our ironclad 60-Day, 100% Money-Back Guarantee. If you are not completely thrilled with the results, you are entitled to a full refund of your purchase price, no questions asked.

2. How to Request a Refund

To request your refund within 60 days of purchase:

  1. Contact our 24/7 customer service desk at support@herpafend.com or call +1 (302) 314-0109.
  2. Provide your order receipt or purchase confirmation number.
  3. Return your used and unused bottles to our designated fulfillment center address provided by support.

3. Processing Time

Once your return is received at our facility, refunds are processed within 3 to 5 business days directly back to your original payment method.
